# Feishu H5 SDK

Version: 1.5.26 (unmodified official distribution).

Source: https://lf1-cdn-tos.bytegoofy.com/goofy/lark/op/h5-js-sdk-1.5.26.js

Retrieved: 2026-10-12.

SHA-256: `1080a3f2492ba78e7a86fb3d4f460921f68a20b44d01c80a04f0b32340859ce3`

Served locally to avoid a CDN dependency during Feishu client sign-in. Keep the
vendor file unchanged. Updates must replace it from the official source and
update the version, digest and integrity test together.

## CSP-compatible variant

`h5-js-sdk-1.5.26.csp.js` is generated by `scripts/build-feishu-sdk.mjs`.
It replaces exactly two `new Function("return this;")()` expressions with
`globalThis`. These constant expressions only obtain the global object; the
replacement preserves that result without enabling `unsafe-eval` in Journey.
The original file above stays unchanged. Tests execute the actual variant with
string code generation disabled and verify the exported login APIs.
